requirement: v2.0.5：Relay 支持 AEAD v2 加密消息信封（enc.v=2 + aad{session_id,machine_id,message_id}），新增能力标记 chat-enc-v2，供主插件启用 encrypted mirror 发送；v1 兼容不变。

assertions.envelope: v2 shape accepted and echoed verbatim (iv/tag + nested aad); v1 still accepted; unknown versions refused BAD_ENCRYPTION
assertions.aadBinding: clear AAD must name the same session_id and machine_id as the message (CHAT_AAD_MISMATCH otherwise); missing aad CHAT_AAD_MISSING; bad message id CHAT_AAD_INVALID
assertions.feature: healthz features includes chat-enc-v2; dispatcher can gate encrypted mirror on it
assertions.tests: fleet-messages + relay-health-capabilities + relay.test 217 pass / 0 fail; targeted v2 suite 28 pass / 0 fail; eslint 0 errors
